content: {"investigate": [{"tool": "sql", "query": "SELECT p.id, p.order_id, p.created_at, p.status, o.id as order_id_exists, o.status as order_status, o.created_at as order_created_at FROM payments p LEFT JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE p.status = 'captured' AND (o.id IS NULL OR o.status != 'confirmed' OR o.created_at > p.created_at + 120) LIMIT 10", "why": "Check if payments reference orders that exist but are not confirmed, or where order creation is too recent (violating the 2-minute window)"}], "hypotheses": [], "summary": "Investigating timing or status issues between payments and orders"}
